summary: This Form 6-K filed by Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. on May 18, 2026, is an operational update regarding the company's Engo Valley uranium project in Namibia. It reports progress toward a maiden mineral resource estimate expected by mid-Q3 2026 and highlights broader nuclear fuel cycle developments. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other category defined in the instructions. It is a routine progress report from a foreign private issuer with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes.
